review_context: Generated synthetic QA run-root was compared against the read-only UI imports and the default UI demo fixture promotion allowlist before pushing to GitHub.
finding_title: Generated QA run-root did not fully cover checked UI fixture promotion sources.
finding_summary: The UI imported POC QA triage and validation-suite evidence fixtures, and promotion required them, but build-synthetic-qa-review-run did not emit those source files at the static allowlisted paths. The L&E replay-readiness report also depended on recursive fallback instead of an exact promotion source path.
observable_context: The promotion allowlist covered all UI imports and additionally required demo-synthetic-qa-bundle-report.json.
The generated run-root missed quality/poc_qa_triage_report.json and quality/validation_suite_evidence_report.json.
The replay-readiness report existed only under a nested quality/le-budget-outcome-replay-readiness/ directory, so promotion relied on fallback filename search.
POC QA triage depends on validation evidence, synthetic QA, blocker, UI bundle, matter-linking, and L&E budget gate artifacts.
observable_decision_logic: Validation evidence must be produced by scripts/run_validation_suite.py with the long timeout policy, not simulated by the synthetic QA builder.
The synthetic QA builder may consume and stage prebuilt validation evidence as candidate local QA input.
Promotion source refs should exist at exact static paths; recursive fallback is a convenience, not the contract.
POC QA triage is a top-level review artifact, but it is not a production approval, Lake write, budget submission, matter opening, or calibration signal.
solution_path: Stage validation evidence as quality/validation_suite_evidence_report.json regardless of the input filename.
Generate quality/poc_qa_triage_report.json when validation evidence is supplied.
Stage labor_employment_budget_outcome_replay_readiness_report.json at the exact quality/ promotion path.
Add tests asserting every default promotion source ref exists in a generated complete run-root.
Update UI documentation with the wrapper-validation then synthetic-QA recipe.
applies_when: A checked frontend demo fixture is promoted from generated local QA artifacts.
A UI import, promotion allowlist, and generated run-root artifact set can drift independently.
A QA dashboard needs wrapper validation evidence before claiming POC QA readiness.
does_not_apply_when: A runtime orchestrator owns artifact assembly and validation evidence.
The UI reads from an owner-approved artifact registry instead of checked local fixtures.
The validation report has not been generated by the wrapper validation suite.
danger_if_misapplied: If generated run-root coverage is assumed from UI imports alone, checked fixtures can become stale or promotion can fail after semantic QA work. If validation evidence is simulated inside the synthetic QA builder, the UI can overstate test confidence.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify UI import/allowlist/run-root drift as a deterministic promotion-coverage exception.
Exception Lake design should keep validation-evidence freshness distinct from semantic QA readiness.
Future repos should add a generated-run-root coverage gate before promoting checked UI fixtures.
reviewer_notes: This record contains synthetic fixture and local artifact references only.
It records observable evidence, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not treat POC QA triage as production readiness.
Do not let a generated run-root create validation evidence without running the wrapper suite.
Do not promote candidate UI fixture schemas or QA labels to Semantic Substrate canon from this repo.
